Web Foundations: From Zero to Your First Line of Code
Learn complete HTML structure and CSS styling from basics to positioning & float techniques. This class is the foundation before moving to modern Flexbox and Grid layouts.
Master modern web layout techniques using one-dimensional CSS Flexbox and two-dimensional CSS Grid to build flexible, responsive, and professional web interfaces.

Master modern web programming logic (ES2015+): let/const variables, data types, operators, if/else flows and loops, arrays & objects, arrow functions, DOM manipulation & event listeners, and introduction to asynchronous concepts through an interactive to-do list project.

Master server-side programming with Node.js runtime: event loop architecture, non-blocking I/O, module systems (CommonJS & ESM), file manipulation, and building HTTP servers & REST APIs. Based on read & predict output method (mental execution) without requiring a compiler in the app.
Learn the programming language with the cleanest syntax. Perfect for data science, scripting automation, and web development.

Master low-level computing foundations: primitive data types, memory pointers, structs, and dynamic heap allocation. Presented with the read & predict output method (mental execution) to build memory intuition without requiring a compiler in the app.
C++ Fundamentals: From C to OOP

Master Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and modern C++ features: references, STL vector & string, classes, RAII constructors/destructors, inheritance, virtual polymorphism, templates, and smart pointers. Based on the read & predict output method (mental execution) without requiring a compiler in the app.
